title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Main guide for natural persons (single filers and couples) for the 2025 return.
notes: States the 31 March 2026 deadline and www.zh.ch/steuererklaerung as online channel. No print date; form codes suggest December 2025.

title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025
why_needed: Only needed when tax liability ends in 2025 (emigration or death).
notes: Cover reads: Bei Beendigung der Steuerpflicht im Jahre 2025 infolge Wegzug ins Ausland oder Tod. The text does not define the UJ code; it is read here as unterjährig.

title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2026 unterjährig
why_needed: Only guide for tax year 2026 found so far; covers liability ending in 2026.
notes: No full-year 2026 Wegleitung was found as of 2026-10-13.

title: How to Fill in Your Tax Return in Paper Form
why_needed: Only English guide found; explains paper filing.
notes: Paper filing only, no ZHprivateTax mention. Refers to 2025 forms (form codes 12.25); embedded Wegleitung cover is marked 2023. Not a full English Wegleitung.

title: Steuererklärung 2025 (für natürliche Personen)
why_needed: Main 2025 return form for individuals and couples, 4 pages.
notes: Form code on this copy is StA Form. 300 (2024) UJ 12.24; the English paper guide cites 300 (2025) 12.25. Check for the newest print before relying on field layout.

title: Wertschriften- und Guthabenverzeichnis mit Verrechnungsantrag
why_needed: Schedule of securities and bank balances valued at 31 Dec 2025, plus Verrechnungssteuer refund request.
notes: Form code StA Form. 340 (2023) 12.25. Splits holdings into groups with and without 35% withholding tax; crypto holdings are declared here.

title: Berufsauslagen 2025
why_needed: Employee professional-expense schedule (commuting, meals, other costs, side income) with its caps.
notes: Form code StA Form. 360 (2024) 12.25. Two columns for Person 1 and Person 2. Amounts are in the form; not copied here.

title: Steuererklärung für ausserhalb des Kantons wohnhafte Personen 2025
why_needed: Only for people living outside Zurich who hold property or business premises in the canton.
notes: Form code StA Form. 303 (2024) UJ 12.24. Page 1 reads Steuererklärung 2025; the non-resident scope is in the subtitle.

title: Wegleitung zu den Formularen DA-1, DA-2 und DA-3
why_needed: Explains foreign withholding tax claims: DA-1 (US-withheld securities) and DA-3 (licence and service income) apply to natural persons.
notes: Form code StA Form. 438 (2025) 12.25. Country lists current as of 1 January 2025. DA-2 is for legal entities only.

title: Steuererklärung Privatpersonen
why_needed: Official overview of ZHprivateTax, AGOV, paper filing, deadlines and extension rules for natural persons.
notes: Lists Wegleitungen and forms for 2024 to 2026. Says Private Tax ends with tax year 2025. Names zhprivatetax.ch and AGOV. Warns about fraud emails. Third-party software not described. No separate PDF links in the text read.

title: Digitale Steuererklärung: Kanton Zürich setzt auf den Online-Kanal ZHprivateTax
why_needed: Official announcement that ZHprivateTax replaces Private Tax and that third-party software is still allowed.
notes: Login is AGOV with strong two-factor authentication. Says third-party software remains possible but gives no conditions, certification or provider list.

title: Verordnung über die elektronische Einreichung der Steuererklärung (LS 631.121)
why_needed: Legal basis for electronic filing; needed to confirm third-party software rules.
notes: Nachtragsnummer 129 is marked aktuell, publication 2025-07-01. Erlass 18.10.2011, in force 01.01.2013. The PDF on notes.zh.ch could not be fetched, so article text is unverified.

title: Weisung der Finanzdirektion über das Steuererklärungsverfahren
why_needed: Sets the filing procedure, deadlines and extension rules for the 2025 return filed in 2026.
notes: Erlass 12.11.2025, in force 01.01.2026. Page metadata shows a later publication date that is not confirmed. Does not cover correcting an already filed return.

title: Steuergesetz (StG), LS 631.1
why_needed: Consolidated cantonal income and wealth tax law; sets the Staatssteuer tariffs in sections 35 and 47.
notes: Nachtragsnummer 132 is marked aktuell. The PDF on notes.zh.ch could not be fetched; this is the HTML ZH-Lex entry.

title: Weisung der Finanzdirektion über Sozialabzüge und Steuertarife (ab Steuerperiode 2015)
why_needed: Rules for which tariff applies to a taxpayer in 2025 (single, married, single parent) and for child and support deductions.
notes: Contains rules only, no tariff tables. Filename says valid until 31.12.2025. Replaced from tax period 2026 by the 2026 Weisung. Tariffs are in StG sections 35 and 47.

title: Weisung der Finanzdirektion über Sozialabzüge und Steuertarife (ab Steuerperiode 2026)
why_needed: Current rules for tariff assignment and social deductions from tax period 2026.
notes: Erlass 17.03.2026, replaces the 2015 Weisung. Contains rules only, no tariff tables. Refers to StG sections 35 (income) and 47 (wealth).

title: Quellensteuer-Tarife
why_needed: Index of all 2026 source-tax tariff PDFs and their codes.
notes: Codes A, B, C and H come with and without church tax; G is one table. L, M, N, P and Q are for German cross-border commuters. The page lists 2025 and older tariffs too.

title: Quellensteuertarif für ausländische Arbeitnehmende, Tarif A ohne Kirchensteuer
why_needed: Monthly source-tax table for single persons (tariff A) for 2026.
notes: Gültig ab 1.1.2026. 8 pages. The other 2026 codes are on the index page and were not fetched one by one.

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung beantragen
why_needed: Deadline and channel for the NOV request (switch from source tax to ordinary assessment).
notes: Deadline: 31 March of the following year, filed electronically, cannot be extended. Earlier if you deregister: by the deregistration date. Online only via ZHServices. Irrevocability is not stated.

title: Quellensteuerkorrektur beantragen
why_needed: Deadline and channel for correcting wrong source-tax deductions.
notes: Deadline: 31 March of the following year, based on the electronic submission date, cannot be extended. Online via ZHServices; no paper form linked.

title: Aktuelle Gemeindesteuerfüsse
why_needed: Official municipal tax-rate table (Gemeindesteuerfuss) that Taxpresso needs per municipality.
notes: Interactive table and map for the current year, continuously updated. Municipalities report by 1 February, mostly complete by mid-March. No downloadable file or static 2025 list was found.

title: Verfügung der Finanzdirektion über die Pauschalierung von Berufsauslagen Unselbstständigerwerbender bei der Steuereinschätzung (ab Steuerperiode 2026)
why_needed: Official basis for employee professional-expense flat rates from tax period 2026.
notes: Erlass 26.09.2025, valid from 01.01.2026. The page does not list the items covered; the change overview says the mileage flat rate rises from 2026.

title: Überblick über Änderungen im Zürcher Steuerbuch
why_needed: Lists the Steuerbuch changes for 2025 and 2026 in one place, including the rental value and mileage changes.
notes: Mentions the 2026 transitional rule for rental values and that the canton does not raise Eigenmietwerte. Links the ZStB entries.

title: Steuerliche Behandlung von Kryptowährungen (Bitcoin etc.)
why_needed: Tax treatment of cryptocurrency holdings for individuals (wealth tax, private gains, business or mining income).
notes: Erlass 20.12.2017. Crypto holdings are wealth-tax items declared in the securities schedule with a wallet printout at year end. Private price gains are income-tax free. Business trading and paid mining follow self-employed rules.

title: Steuergesetz (StG) vom 8. Juni 1997, LS 631.1 (Nachtrag 127, Stand 1.1.2025)
why_needed: Law text in force for tax year 2025: income tariff in section 35, wealth tariff in section 47, deductions in sections 26, 31 and 34.
notes: Downloaded as PDF (102 pages). Page footer reads 1. 1. 25 - 127. ZH-Lex marks it in force until 01.01.2026. Tariff footnote cites the cold progression ordinance from 1 January 2024. The OpenAttachment link on the ZH-Lex page answers with a JavaScript redirect; this is the direct WebView file URL it points to.

title: Steuergesetz (StG) vom 8. Juni 1997, LS 631.1 (Nachtrag 132, Stand 1.4.2026)
why_needed: Current law text for tax year 2026: income tariff in section 35, wealth tariff in section 47, deductions in sections 26, 31 and 34.
notes: PDF version of the ZH-Lex entry zh-na-law-steuergesetz-631-1 (102 pages, footer 1. 4. 26 - 132, marked aktuell). Tariff footnote cites the cold progression ordinance from 1 January 2026. Nachtrag 131 (Stand 1.1.2026) has the same tariffs. Direct WebView file URL, see the 2025 entry.

title: Verordnung über den Ausgleich der kalten Progression bei der Einkommens- und Vermögenssteuer ab 1. Januar 2024
publisher: Finanzdirektion des Kantons Zürich (Zürcher Steuerbuch Nr. 48.1)
why_needed: Sets the income and wealth tariff brackets (sections 35 and 47) and the indexed deduction amounts that apply to tax years 2024 and 2025.
notes: Ordinance of 28 June 2023, in force 1 January 2024 (5 pages). Rewrites StG sections 24, 31, 34, 35 and 47. Replaced by the ordinance from 1 January 2026, so it is the tariff source for 2025.

title: Verordnung über den Ausgleich der kalten Progression bei der Einkommens- und Vermögenssteuer ab 1. Januar 2026
publisher: Finanzdirektion des Kantons Zürich (Zürcher Steuerbuch Nr. 48.1)
why_needed: Sets the income and wealth tariff brackets and the indexed deduction amounts (childcare, further education, gambling, party donations, dual earner) from tax year 2026.
notes: Ordinance of 30 June 2025, OS 80, 273 (4 pages). Rewrites StG sections 24, 31, 34, 35 and 47. States lit. a to g of section 31 unchanged. The same URL may be reused for a later ordinance; check the title.

title: Beschluss des Kantonsrates über die Festsetzung des Steuerfusses für die Jahre 2024 und 2025 (LS 631.21)
why_needed: Cantonal multiplier (Staatssteuerfuss, in percent of the einfache Staatssteuer) for tax year 2025.
notes: One page, decision of 12 December 2023, Nachtrag 123. Also lists earlier multipliers. ZStB 2.1.

title: Beschluss des Kantonsrates über die Festsetzung des Steuerfusses für die Jahre 2026 und 2027 (LS 631.21)
why_needed: Cantonal multiplier (Staatssteuerfuss) for tax years 2026 and 2027.
notes: One page, decision of 15 December 2025, in force 1 January 2026, Nachtrag 132 (aktuell). Lists the 2024 and 2025 multiplier as an earlier rate. ZStB 2.1.

title: Steuerfüsse seit 2012 (Bezogene Gemeindesteuerfüsse, in Prozent der einfachen Staatssteuer)
publisher: Amt für Statistik und Daten des Kantons Zürich (Statistisches Amt)
why_needed: Municipal multipliers for all 160 communes, with and without church tax (reformed, Catholic, Christ Catholic), one sheet per year including STFUSS2025 and STFUSS2026.
notes: Open data resource 1150 of the cantonal statistics office, listed on the zh.ch page Aktuelle Gemeindesteuerfüsse through its data API. Sheet headers: Bezogene Gemeindesteuerfüsse <year> / Gewogene Mittel, In Prozent der einfachen Staatssteuer. Modified date from the data catalogue.

title: Zürcher Gemeindesteuerfüsse: Zeitreihe
publisher: Amt für Statistik und Daten des Kantons Zürich (Statistisches Amt)
why_needed: Machine-readable municipal multipliers by year and BFS number; has 160 rows each for 2025 and 2026.
notes: Open data resource 1776. Columns YEAR, BFSNR, GDE_NAME, STF_O_KIRCHE1..3, STF_REF1..3, STF_KATH1..3, STF_CKRKATH1..3, JUR_PERS. Column meanings are not documented in the file; read them against the xlsx headers.

title: Zürcher Gemeindesteuerfüsse: aktuell
publisher: Amt für Statistik und Daten des Kantons Zürich (Statistisches Amt)
why_needed: Current-year municipal multipliers with a status flag (definitiv or not) and the change against the previous year.
notes: Open data resource 1775, the data behind the interactive zh.ch table. As of 2026-10-13 all 160 rows are YEAR 2026, FLAG definitiv, LAST_REFRESH 24.03.2026. The same URL will switch to 2027 data next year.

title: Verfügung der Finanzdirektion über die Pauschalierung von Berufsauslagen Unselbstständigerwerbender bei der Steuereinschätzung (ab Steuerperiode 2024), LS 631.33
why_needed: Employee flat rates (commuting, meals, other professional costs, side income) for tax years 2024 and 2025.
notes: Verfügung of 3 October 2023, 4 pages, Nachtrag 123. ZH-Lex marks it in force until 01.01.2026, so it governs tax year 2025. ZStB 26.1 (old version).

title: Verfügung der Finanzdirektion über die Pauschalierung von Berufsauslagen Unselbstständigerwerbender bei der Steuereinschätzung (ab Steuerperiode 2026), LS 631.33
why_needed: Employee flat rates from tax year 2026; the text behind the HTML entry zh-2026-deductions-berufsauslagen-zstb-26-1.
notes: Verfügung of 26 September 2025, 4 pages, Nachtrag 131 (aktuell), in force 1 January 2026.

title: Versicherungsprämien 2025
why_needed: Insurance premium and savings interest schedule for 2025 with the cantonal and federal caps printed on it.
notes: Form code StA Form. 365 (2024) 12.25, 1 page. Linked from the Steuererklärung Privatpersonen page. Legal basis is StG section 31 paragraph 1 lit. g.

title: Versicherungsprämien 2026
why_needed: Insurance premium schedule for 2026 with its caps; the full-year 2026 form set is not published yet.
notes: Form code StA Form. 365 (2024) 12.26, 1 page. Stored in the unterjährig (est-formulare-uj) folder. Replace with the full-year form when it appears.

title: Berufsorientierte Aus- und Weiterbildungskosten 2025
why_needed: Schedule for job-related training costs in 2025, per person.
notes: Form code StA Form. 367 (2024) 12.25, 1 page. Cap is in StG section 31 paragraph 1 lit. k.

title: Berufsauslagen 2026
why_needed: Employee professional-expense schedule for 2026 with the new flat rates printed on it.
notes: Form code StA Form. 360 (2025) 12.26, 2 pages. Stored in the unterjährig folder; the full-year 2026 form set is not published yet.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes über die Gewährung von Sozialabzügen und die Anwendung der Steuertarife bei Familien (ab Steuerperiode 2019)
why_needed: Which parent gets the child deduction, the support deduction and the married tariff, for married, separated and unmarried parents (cantonal and federal).
notes: Merkblatt of 20 April 2021, Stand 1 January 2021, applicable from tax period 2019, 15 pages. Still the current version on the Steuerbuch page. Read with the 2026 Weisung ZStB 34.1.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes über die steuerliche Abzugsberechtigung für Beiträge an anerkannte Formen der gebundenen Selbstvorsorge (3. Säule a)
why_needed: Pillar 3a maximum deductions per year, with and without a pension fund.
notes: One page, Merkblatt of 11 September 2024. Last row reads ab 2025; no separate 2026 row. Older versions are kept on the ZStB 31.1 page.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes Zürich zu den Abzügen der Krankheits- und Unfallkosten sowie der behinderungsbedingten Kosten
why_needed: Rules for medical and accident costs (with the 5 percent threshold) and disability costs.
notes: 6 pages, version of 19 July 2005 as amended 18 September 2012 and 5 June 2013. Header still shows the old number 19/002.

title: Steuererklärung 2025 für natürliche Personen
why_needed: Full-year main return form 2025 (4 pages); the existing zh-2025-form-steuererklaerung entry is the unterjährig print.
notes: Form code StA Form. 300 (2025) 12.25. Linked from the Steuererklärung Privatpersonen page as Steuererklärung 2025.

title: Aufforderung zur Einreichung von Steuererklärungen und Verrechnungsanträgen im Jahr 2026
publisher: Finanzdirektion des Kantons Zürich (Zürcher Steuerbuch Nr. 133.1)
why_needed: Official call to file the 2025 return: who must file, deadlines, special cases and extension rules.
notes: 7 pages, dated 21 August 2025, published in the Amtsblatt on 9 January and 6 March 2026.

title: Aufforderung zur Einreichung von Steuererklärungen und Verrechnungsanträgen im Jahr 2027
publisher: Finanzdirektion des Kantons Zürich (Zürcher Steuerbuch Nr. 133.1)
why_needed: Official call to file the 2026 return: who must file and the 31 March 2027 deadline.
notes: 7 pages, dated 4 August 2026, to be published in the Amtsblatt on 8 January and 5 March 2027.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes zur Erstellung der Steuererklärung mit elektronischen Hilfsmitteln (PC) (vom 15. November 2005)
why_needed: Rules for returns made with third-party PC software that apply until 31 December 2026, so to the 2025 return.
notes: 4 pages, old number 31/203. Private programs may be used; the canton does not certify (homologieren) them but checks printouts for scanning if sent by 30 November. File name says valid until 31.12.2026.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes zur Erstellung der Steuererklärung mit elektronischen Hilfsmitteln (vom 30. September 2026)
why_needed: Third-party software rules from 1 January 2027 (2026 returns): printed forms and electronic transmission by third-party solutions.
notes: 2 pages, in force 1 January 2027, replaces the 2005 Merkblatt. Printouts must match the official forms and carry the provider name. Electronic transmission by third parties is recognised but not an automatic right: XML per eCH-0119 or eCH-0276, Zurich tax logic and the Belegregelwerk; providers apply by email to the address in the document.

title: Verordnung über die elektronische Einreichung der Steuererklärung vom 18. Oktober 2011, LS 631.121 (Nachtrag 129)
why_needed: Text of the e-filing ordinance behind zh-na-efiling-verordnung-631-121, which could not be read before.
notes: 4 pages, footer 1. 7. 25 - 129. Covers the canton's own applications: authentication, electronic confirmation by both spouses, attachments filed electronically, and a corrected return after submission (section 9). It does not mention third-party software; see ZStB 109c.3.

title: Merkblatt des kantonalen Steueramtes über die Quellenbesteuerung von Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmern
